name: Tachiarai (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Tachiarai town emblem in white: a fan-shaped device enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tachiarai, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1972.

features.role: Tachiarai town emblem — a fan-shaped device enclosing a stylised character
